## Sharing cake {#ss7-cake .lim-lesson .lim-cake-slide}

Mr Greasley shares a cake equally with his two favourite (but greedy) students.

They ask for more, so he divides **his remaining piece into thirds** again, giving one piece to each student.

<div class="lim-cake" data-module="cake-sharing"></div>

::: notes

Use the physical cake alongside the model. Share again makes one equal three-way split of the teacher’s current share. Initially the whole cake belongs to Mr Greasley. Ask students to predict before every cut. Reveal fractions independently shows the extra piece, each student’s accumulated share and the teacher’s remaining share. Up to six rounds are shown at their exact proportions. The lower strip magnifies the teacher’s piece immediately before the current cut and is explicitly labelled as enlarged, not an additional cake. Round n gives each student 1/3^n extra, total (1−3^(−n))/2, and leaves the teacher 3^(−n). Reset returns to the whole cake, round zero and hidden fractions. State persists through slide navigation. Source: teacher’s Geometric Limiting Sum.pptx slides 4–5.

:::
